messages:
sam: Quick status — PR #23890 (optimize-batching) is green locally but CI is failing a windows-e2e timeout (seq2seq test). Need advice: rebase now or wait for rebase window?
ci-bot: Build failed — job: ci/windows-e2e/48231 — timeout at 22:11 UTC — logs: https://ci.internal/48231
sam: @jordan deploy-freeze starts in ~2h (23:00 UTC). If we wait we miss the freeze window. Rebase now or hold for the 03:00 UTC rebase slot?
alex: I can review quickly, but we need a green CI to merge. If it's a transient flake we can rerun and try to land before freeze. :eyes:
maria: windows runners have been flaky today. Suggest trying a manual rerun first. If it fails repeatedly, we can consider SKIP_FLAKY or mark test flaky, but that's a separate change. Pinging infra.
infra-bot: Re-run requested by @sam for job 48231 — queued (manual trigger) — rerun id 48232.
ci-bot: Rerun completed — 48232 — failed same test — failure snippet: 
```Error: Timeout waiting for seq2seq model download
    at tests/e2e/seq.test:42
```
sam: Reran twice, still hitting the same timeout. Options: (1) light rebase + push (fast CI), (2) request exception to land despite flaky windows (not ideal), (3) defer to next rebase window at 03:00 UTC. Thoughts?
jordan: Given the freeze soon, don't do risky merges. If PR is small and non-customer-facing, we could ask for a canary landing, but prefer to defer unless rebase solves it.
alex: I'm +1 to try a quick rebase first — if it clears CI I can approve. If it doesn't, hold for the 03:00 slot.
devex: FYI the team rebase window is 03:00–03:30 UTC (docs: https://internal/docs/rebase-windows). If you're fine waiting we can schedule it.
sam: Plan: I'll do a light rebase and force-push in ~5m, will ping here. If CI still flakes we'll hold for 03:00 UTC. @maria can you watch the windows runners while I do this?
maria: I'll tail the runner logs and notify if infra-wide issue. Opening a flaky-test ticket now.
alex: Quick review done, small nits fixed — LGTM. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: New build 48245 queued (after rebase) — triggered by sam.
ci-bot: Build 48245 — windows-e2e initially failed, retried job, retry 1 passed — overall status: green. :tada:
sam: Great — merging now. Thanks all for the quick help! :rocket:
